    en_i           = 1'b1;
    test_mode_en_i = 1'b0;
    div_i          = 4'd0;
    div_valid_i    = 1'b0;
  end

  int      errors    = 0;
  int      rise_cnt  = 0;
  realtime t_last_rise = 0.0;
  realtime t_last_fall = 0.0;

  always @(posedge clk_o) begin rise_cnt++;    t_last_rise = $realtime; end

        t  = $realtime;
        ok = 1'b1;
      end

        repeat (budget) @(posedge clk);
      end
